title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Women’s Rights Programme in Nepal, implemented by ActionAid and local partners aims to support local women's organisations to be strong, resilient and representative. The main objective is to support women's organisations and women's groups to lead on local and national solidarity movements that demand for the end of GBV and advocate for women's rights to be respected and realised. Objective: Women and girls' networks and coalitions are mobilized and supported to actively lead local and national solidarity movements and campaigns, demanding an end to VAWG, fair wages and influencing laws and policies related to this issues thereby bringing grassroots women’s issues to the forefront at federal level. Outcome: Cross cutting outcome - Women's organisations are strong, resilient and representative
